title: CursorExpiredFrame
description: Notification that a requested subscription cursor is older than the stream retention window. Client must perform a full snapshot resynchronization for this topic.

type.description: Server control frame discriminator. A text frame carrying `type` is a control frame; a text frame without it is a stream envelope.

topic.description: The topic whose cursor has expired.

cursor.description: The expired cursor provided by the client, if available.
